approvalSettings.baselineRiskDetectionAl: Baseline risk detection always applies; legacy disabled hints do not disable it. Existing denial settings remain effective. approvalSettings.thePolicyAppliesToEvery: The policy applies to every access profile, including legacy time-limited access. Locking, authorization scope, expiry and host verification still apply.
approvalSettings.systemStateVersionsFile: System state, versions, file metadata, logs and bounded HTTP/TLS probes may pass after each segment is verified. AI is not required. Explicit rules take priority.
approvalSettings.supportsSemicolonsNewli: Supports semicolons, newlines, &&, ||, pipes and literal echo / printf; 2>&1, /dev/null redirection and bounded timeout. Relative paths are checked against the requested directory. Limits: 32 queries, 40 segments, 16384 characters.
approvalSettings.coversResourcesPortsPro: Covers resources, ports/processes, disks, network metadata, registered versions, containers/services, paths and file metadata. Use tail/head or query_application_logs for large logs.
approvalSettings.curlIsRestrictedToHeadA: curl is restricted to HEAD and fixed health-path GET on localhost or the current server. Config, proxies, credentials, redirects and file output are disabled; limits: 10 seconds / 256 KiB. TLS uses bounded handshakes/public certificate information without application data. Text filtering, sorting, slicing and bounded field extraction may be combined.
approvalSettings.writesStartStopActionsD: Writes, start/stop actions, dynamic expansion, general scripts and unsupported arguments still need confirmation. Command names in labels/search terms are not treated as execution. Remote programs, environment, file contents and links remain trust boundaries; queries are not guaranteed to have zero side effects.
approvalSettings.providesAdviceForUnmatc: Provides advice for unmatched rules. AI cannot independently authorize arbitrary commands.

approvalSettings.highRiskActionsRequireM: High-risk actions require manual approval by default; they may be changed to denial.
approvalSettings.keywordDetectionMayProd: Keyword detection may produce false positives or miss risks.

approvalSettings.unrecognizedCommandsNee: Unrecognized commands need approval by default. Automatic execution requires exact custom command rules.
